name: Define task MCP server

plannedActions.name: Research MCP protocol specification and architecture
Study existing MCP server implementations for reference patterns
Map ITaskWorld protocol operations to MCP tools (createTask, updateTask, pushTaskId, etc.)
Define MCP resources schema for tasks (enable AI to read task list as context)
Design tool schemas for all task operations with parameter types and validation
Document server initialization, configuration (basePath), and lifecycle

references.text: Primary API to wrap with MCP

summary: Design and specify an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for scv-tasks to enable AI assistants to interact with tasks through structured protocol calls instead of CLI commands.
